basis: marginal paid usage after shared allowances, per one million cold full JSON requests
notes: This is a sample estimate, not an invoice. Eight selected blocks do not establish the whole-history mean CPU.
Excludes the $5/month Workers account subscription, shared free/included allowances, rounding, taxes, index/source storage, construction PUTs, observability logs and analytics queries.
Worker CPU is billed only for compute, not network wait. CPU uses the measured mean, not p50.
Each request authenticates with one KV key read, including response-cache hits. Cache hits use zero R2 operations but still use Worker request/CPU and KV resources.
The Analytics Engine pricing page currently states no usage billing. Its announced future write rate is $0.25 per million after included usage; it is not added to this current subtotal.
The existing customer price of $1 per million archive-backed requests was not changed.
